line: I want money like I’m HOVA (Jay Z!)
vault_lines: I want money like I'm HOVA (Jay Z!)
meaning: HOVA is a nickname for Jay Z, derived from Jehovah, the Hebrew word for God. As of 2016, Jay is worth abundant $610 million. Who wouldn’t want money like that?

line: VVS’s cause they colder VVS’s cause they colder
meaning: VVS diamonds are the second highest clarity grade for diamonds. 21 got himself some VVS diamond jewelry because they’re more expensive and flashy than your ordinary diamonds.

line: Donovan money McNabb Like the Joker I laugh
meaning:
Donovan McNabb was the quarterback for the Philadelphia Eagles. Thug is comparing his ridiculous amount of money to that of the former professional NFL player.



T.I. has stated in an interview with DJ Drama earlier this year that Thug is indeed “the closest thing to the Joker” (14:48) the popular villain who’s known for his eccentric behavior, passion for violence and randomness.

line: In my face I got a dagger
vault_lines: In my face I got a dagger
meaning: 21 Savage shows how menacing he is by referencing the dagger he has tattooed on his forehead. Click here  to see 21 explain the meaning of his tattoo.

line: I move that work like the first, ayy
vault_lines: I move that work like the first, ayy
meaning: On the first of the month welfare recipients get a government check, which they can use to buy drugs.  This creates a perfect opportunity for Uzi to trap his work, or move the drugs he’s trying to sell.

line: You was playing games, nigga I was in the field You had an Xbox, nigga I had a piece of steel
vault_lines: You was playing games, nigga I was in the field
meaning:
While majority of the kids growing up spent their time playing video games, 21 was in the streets, getting involved in criminal activities, playing with guns (steel) instead of a console.

He’s alluded to this before on his 2016 song “No Heart”:

You was with your friends playin' Nintendo
I was playin' ‘round with that fire

Brown Heroin aka Dog Food
